STEPS TAKEN, CONT.
• Met with John Brodie, Tom Cobb, and TJ Barttelbort to determine
  how the properties could be:
    • Inventoried
    • Prioritized
    • Surveyed
    • Obtain market values
    • Negotiate right of way
• Discussion ensued around capacity of the City Engineer’s office and
  that many of these pieces of property may have drainage, WAPA,
  and Right of Way considerations. Many may involve platting or re-
  platting.
